avis.titre: I really wanted to love it!!!
avis.texte: I really wanted to love it!!! After reading the reviews, I was sold. I love Dermologica products and thought I would feel the same about this one. It sits on the surface of my face so badly my face would get stuck to the pillow at night. It is a nice thick serum so it does not drip down your face like most. However, no visible results noted. Not for my 40+ year old face anyways.

I have been using the product for about two weeks now. All you need is 3 or 4 drops for your face and it goes on smoothly. I have definitely noticed my skin brighter since I have started using it. I haven't noticed much difference in my fine lines but will update my comment once I have used it for several weeks. The product has a nice scent and does leave your skin a bit tacky once applied. I let it sit on my skin for about 5 min prior to applying my moisturizer. For now, I will definitely recommend. For reference I am 43 years old and I use this in combination with a retinol treatment.

I feel like now that I tried it. This is part of my regimen I cannot live without. I wake up refreshed. I feel like my skin looks better than the night before I started to notice the difference in a week. Honest answer is the nighttime more results than the daytime bottle

I went into this product with a bit of hesitation as I have a sensitive skin type. Alas, some recent skin spots had me seeking out brightening products, so I figured testing this product (which I received complimentary from the brand) seemed like a wise idea! The first thing I noticed was that the texture is quite unique. It feels lighter than water almost (think of how oils feel) and yet has the opposite body of oils. It's actually somehow both lightweight and non-runny! The scent is pretty strong, but it passed both the patch test as well as subsequent usage. I do appreciate that this product is using Aminopropyl Ascorbyl Phosphate, which is an interesting new derivative (based on L-AA and 3-APPA). The Korean lab which developed this ingredient claims that their clinical trials revealed a significant reduction in hyperpigmentation and dramatic decrease in wrinkles, albeit in 8 weeks. So I do think that Dermalogica's claims of overnight results sound nice, but as per usual, it's best to stick with the product for a couple of months. One note before I end my review: given the essential oils in this product, I would recommend a patch test prior to use. It worked for me but it's challenging to say whether it will work for everyone!
